description: 津波断層モデル(8)初期水位データ 07系 0810 99 [tsunami and earthquakes] (series on G-spatial Information Center) is a series of datasets listed in G-spatial Information Center (G空間情報センター), Japan, an open data portal, published or maintained by 内閣府　南海トラフの巨大地震モデル検討会. 内閣府の南海トラフの巨大地震モデル検討会において検討を行なった震度分布・浸水域等に係るデータです。 （８）初期水位データ 断層によるコサイスミックな地殻変動量（上下方向）のデータ 問い合わせの際には、問い合わせフォームの「ご意見、ご感想」記入欄の冒頭に【震度分布・浸水域等に係るデータに関する問い合わせ】... Coverage: Japan. The portal lists 13 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher 内閣府　南海トラフの巨大地震モデル検討会. Its tags are 中国地方, 中部地方, 九州地方, 南海トラフ, 四国地方. It offers 14 resource(s) in pdf, zip. The portal shows 2024-10-04 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is the data owner's own terms of use (see the dataset page). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-gsi-portal.
